intro.text: A kingdom north of the Idrian mountains, close to Kuth. The two were allies in the Manywar, and Hanald invaded both.

description.text: Little is recorded about its climate, except that the land was prairie, steppe or desert.
Huth was on poor terms with Hanald, envying its wealth and fearing its armies.

items.text: Roughly three centuries ago, just before the Manywar, tensions with Hanald peaked. One cause was Hanald's monopoly on dyes, which kept other kingdoms from sharing in that trade.

Hanald's royals had also embraced the young art of Awakening, gaining strong Awakeners and Lifeless that other realms lacked. New discoveries let nations field much larger, cheaper armies, raising tensions further.
Then one of Hanald's Returned foresaw war, and Kalad struck first at Huth and other nations.
The Manywar broke out as Kalad's Phantoms marched into Huth and Kuth.
Huth and Kuth became Hanald's main enemies and kept fighting until, close to the war's end, both kingdoms were destroyed.
Several kingdoms arose in Huth's place, and they kept their hatred of Hallandren. Some three hundred years after its fall, a tyrant backed by Yesteel set out to bring Huth and Kuth back.
